# Draft:27th Screen Awards

}}
The 27th Screen Awards also The Chetak Screen Awards ceremony, presented by Indian Express Group, honoured the best Indian Hindi-language films of 2025. The ceremony was held on 5 April 2026 at Mumbai, hosted by Alia Bhatt, Saurabh Dwivedi, Sunil Grover and Zakir Khan.
Awards and Nominations
The winners and nominees have been listed below. Winners are listed first, highlighted in boldface, and indicated with a double dagger ().
